note: 男性長輩 a akey：負責漁獵、飛魚季出海、拼板舟的決定。idle 依 when（time / seasons）挑選，沒有符合的就用第一組。

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 飛魚季出海、漁網和船組的事，椰油這邊我在看。
duty.en: Going to sea in flying fish season, the nets, the boat crews — in Yayo, I keep an eye on all that.

duty.zh: 網是一家人的飯碗，破了就要補。
duty.en: The net feeds a whole family. When it tears, you mend it.

lines.zh: 港口的船來來去去，可是海還是那片海。
lines.en: Boats come and go at the harbour, but the sea is still the same sea.

lines.zh: 晚上了，早點回家。明天的海，明天再看。
lines.en: It's night. Go home early. Tomorrow's sea can wait for tomorrow.

lines.zh: 飛魚季到了，船組天還沒亮就要準備。
lines.en: Flying fish season is here. The boat crews get ready before dawn.

lines.zh: alibangbang 回來了，大家都忙起來。
lines.en: The alibangbang are back, and everyone is busy.

lines.zh: 冬天浪大，正好在家補網。
lines.en: Big waves in winter. A good time to mend nets at home.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 造 tatala、上山選木頭，朗島這邊找我。
duty.en: Building a tatala, choosing wood up the mountain — in Iraraley, come to me.

duty.zh: 一條船要好多人一起做，不是一個人的。
duty.en: A boat takes many people to build. It never belongs to just one.

lines.zh: 朗島的潮間帶很大，退潮時去看看。
lines.en: The tide flats of Iraraley are huge. Go have a look at low tide.

lines.zh: 晚上山裡很暗，不要自己上山。
lines.en: The mountain is dark at night. Don't go up alone.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的船都下水了，今年的船跑得很好。
lines.en: All the boats are in the water for flying fish season. This year's boats run well.

lines.zh: 冬天要決定先修哪一條船。
lines.en: In winter we decide which boat to fix first.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 出海的繩子、槳，東清這邊我在教。
duty.en: Ropes and paddles for the sea — in Iranmeylek, I'm the one who teaches that.

duty.zh: 海上的事要自己看清楚，不要靠別人。
duty.en: At sea you must see things for yourself. Don't rely on others.

lines.zh: 東清灣的早晨最早亮，遊客也最早來。
lines.en: Dongqing Bay gets the first light of morning — and the first tourists.

lines.zh: 聽，浪聲變大了，明天風會比較強。
lines.en: Listen, the waves are getting louder. The wind will be stronger tomorrow.

lines.zh: 飛魚季時，灘頭的規矩要守好。
lines.en: In flying fish season, keep the rules of the boat beach.

lines.zh: 冬天的海不讓人出去，我們就等。
lines.en: The winter sea won't let us out, so we wait.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 飛魚季的規矩、魚怎麼分，野銀的男人一起商量，我年紀最大，大家會來問我。
duty.en: The flying fish rules and how to share the catch — the men of Ivalino decide together. I'm the oldest, so everyone asks me.

lines.zh: 野銀的老房子還在，是祖先留給我們的。想拍，先問屋主。
lines.en: The old houses of Ivalino are still here. Our ancestors left them to us. If you want a photo, ask the owner first.

lines.zh: 老人家晚上就是坐著，聽海、想以前的事。
lines.en: At night, old folks just sit, listen to the sea, and think about the past.

lines.zh: 分魚的時候，不能忘記行動不方便的長輩。
lines.en: When sharing the fish, never forget the elders who can't get around.

lines.zh: 冬天的風很冷，老房子比較暖。
lines.en: Winter wind is cold. The old houses stay warmer.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 山上的事我比較熟：羊、樹、山路。
duty.en: I know the mountain best: goats, trees, mountain paths.

duty.zh: 上山要跟大人一起，不要亂走。
duty.en: Go up the mountain with an adult. Don't wander off.

lines.zh: 紅頭山上的羊又跑遠了。
lines.en: The goats on Mt. Hongtou have wandered far again.

lines.zh: 晚上不上山，山有山的規矩。
lines.en: We don't go up the mountain at night. The mountain has its own rules.

lines.zh: 紅頭是飛魚的故事開始的地方。
lines.en: Imorod is where the flying fish story began.

lines.zh: 冬天草長得慢，羊會跑到比較低的地方。
lines.en: Grass grows slowly in winter, so the goats come down lower.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 漁人的船組出海、分魚，問我就對了。
duty.en: Boat crews going to sea and sharing fish in Iratay — just ask me.

lines.zh: 飛機起起落落，可是我們的船還是用划的。
lines.en: Planes come and go, but we still paddle our boats.

lines.zh: 灘頭晚上很安靜，船都在休息。
lines.en: The boat beach is quiet at night. The boats are resting.

lines.zh: 飛魚季，族男可以跟我們船組出海。只有男人去。
lines.en: In flying fish season, the Tao man can go to sea with our boat crew. Only men go.

lines.zh: 冬天風大，大家在家整理漁具。
lines.en: Strong winds in winter. Everyone sorts their fishing gear at home.
